parts:
Hello All,

Ever had some code stop running in the middle? Snakemake to the rescue! Need to switch from your local computer to the cloud? Snakemake can do that! Want a detailed, repeatable, automated description of everything you ran? Snakemake is your solution! Love conda? Snakemake.

We'll finish the tutorial we started last week.

Hope to see you there!

Time: 3:00pm-5:00pm
Location: 2020 Valley Hall (http://campusmap.ucdavis.edu/?b=178). It's on the second floor, near the elevator.

Description

Meet and Analyze Data (MAD) is a community focused on tackling biological big data questions ranging from high level concepts (what is metagenome assembly?) to low level coding problems (what does this error message even mean!?) and everything in between. Each week will start with a short lesson to share important tools for project management and data analysis designed to help us level up our skills. Then, participants with expertise in a variety of areas will be available to help with individual research and coding questions. To facilitate this discussion, all questions must be posted on the MAD discourse forum. Help us help you: please try to post your questions ahead of time, and be kind to our helpers as they try to get to all the questions! To keep things fun for everyone, please check out our Code of Conduct.
